newsitem.title: CANADA: Inco makes US$132 mln from Doncasters IPO.
newsitem.headline: Inco makes US$132 mln from Doncasters IPO.

text.p: Inco Ltd said on Wednesday that it will realize gross proceeds of US$132 million from its initial public offering of eight million American Depository Shares of its engineered products unit, Doncasters PLC.
Each American Depository Share in the initial public offering was priced at US$16.50, Inco said in a release.
Inco is selling 100 percent of its interest in Doncasters through the offering, which will close in the first week of February.
The underwriters have an option to purchase up to 800,000 additional shares to cover any over-allotments, Inco said.
Inco said it plans to use the net proceeds for general corporate purposes, including the repayment of debt from its acquisition of Diamond Fields Resources Inc last August.
Doncasters manufactures highly engineered components for the aerospace and industrial gas and steam turbine industries. It has operations in the United Kingdom, the United States and Belgium.
